settings.heading:
More than
just a pet.
settings.body: At Albies Pet Supplies, we believe dogs are cherished members of the family. We create practical, dependable gear to make everyday life together happier, healthier and more enjoyable.

settings.heading: Life with a dog doesn't always go to plan.
settings.body:
Pulling on the lead. Muddy walks. Early mornings. Late nights. Weekend adventures. The unexpected moments in between.

We wanted to make those everyday experiences easier with gear that feels dependable when you need it most.

settings.heading: Built around real life with dogs.
settings.intro: Three simple principles guide everything we do - because every dog, every walk and every adventure is different.
settings.card_1_text: Gear designed for powerful dogs and those moments when you need a little more control.
settings.card_2_text: Hands-free and adventure-ready essentials for running, hiking and longer walks.
settings.card_3_lead: Peace of mind, day or night.
settings.card_3_text: Visibility-focused gear to help keep dogs seen when the light starts to fade.

settings.heading:
Better lives for pets.
Better lives together.
settings.body:
We believe pets deserve the same thought and care we give the people we love.

That's why we focus on high-quality supplies that support a happy, healthy and vibrant life together - from everyday walks around the neighbourhood to adventures further afield.

And because not every dog has found their forever home, we proudly dedicate a portion of our proceeds to supporting local animal shelters and rescues.
settings.feature_text: A purchase that helps a little further.

settings.heading: Made for life together.
settings.body: Gear for stronger walks, longer adventures and safer nights.
